1: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
2: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
3: Who has prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
4: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
5: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
6: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
7: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
8: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
9: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
10: By his exhaling a light does shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
11: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
12: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
13: His breath kindles coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.
14: In his neck remains strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
15: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
16: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
17: When he raises up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
18: The sword of him that lays at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the armour of jacket.
19: He esteems iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
20: The arrow cannot make him flee: sling stones are turned with him into stubble.
21: Darts are counted as stubble: he laughs at the shaking of a spear.
22: Sharp stones are under him: he spreads sharp pointed things upon the mire.
23: He makes the deep to boil like a pot: he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
24: He makes a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
25: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
26: He beholds all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
